title: Acquirer: OneSteel Reinforcing Pty Ltd; Target: Marner Steel and Mesh

body_sections.Summary: OneSteel Reinforcing Pty Ltd located in Adelaide proposes to acquire Marner Steel and Mesh also based in Adelaide.
body_sections.Market definition: The South Australian market for steel reinforcing bar and mesh
body_sections.Competition analysis: Following market inquiries with competitors and customers, the Commission considered that the proposed acquisition would be unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition because: OneSteel intends to maintain the Marner operations and service its present customer base; Two other producers, Smorgon ARC and Bianco, are capable of competing actively with the merged entity; and Recent entry by Bianco and price discounting suggest the market will remain both contestable and competitive.
